description: EPANET simulations introduce individual leaks at Hanoi and Anytown nodes under 20 variations of a 24-hour demand pattern. Demand multipliers vary between zero and two, with emitter coefficient fixed at one. This resource is provided by Arvin Ajoodani. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These controlled benchmark scenarios do not represent calibrated leak distributions in real networks. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
